summary: Bearer is Resistant to wounds (the next wound); outside the Enchantment limit; not with other (m) Protection Enchantments.

effects.subject: bearer
effects.note: Resistant to wounds: does not receive the next wound that would otherwise be inflicted.

restrictions.note: Unless the other Protection Enchantment is (ex).

termination.note: Resistant means unaffected by the next wound (Resistant definition); the text does not say the strip is removed.

clarifications.text: May be worn alongside Protection School Enchantments that are (ex), but not with (m) ones.

open_questions: Whether the Enchantment is removed once the Resistance is used is not stated in its own text; the general rule that Enchantments with a definite number of uses are removed when the last use is expended (it names Blessing Against Harm) probably applies.
